eyebrow: OLTP: computed live, from normalized tables
code:
SELECT YEAR(h.OrderDate) AS SalesYear, SUM(d.LineTotal) AS TotalSales
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader AS h
JOIN Sales.SalesOrderDetail AS d
  ON d.SalesOrderID = h.SalesOrderID
GROUP BY YEAR(h.OrderDate);
caption: AdventureWorks2012 — real OLTP, built for placing and managing individual orders.

eyebrow: OLAP: pre-shaped for exactly this question
code:
SELECT d.CalendarYear, SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS TotalSales
FROM dbo.FactInternetSales AS f
JOIN dbo.DimDate AS d ON d.DateKey = f.OrderDateKey
GROUP BY d.CalendarYear;
caption: AdventureWorksDW2014 — the SAME company's data, restructured for fast historical analysis.

subtitle: The system built for exactly this kind of question.
